patterns: APPSC asks one-line identity facts: Sri Sri = 'Poet of the Millennium', Gopichand = psychological novel Asamarthuni Jeevayatra (G2 2017), Gorky's Mother translator Krovvidi Lingaraju (GS 2019).
Name-collision traps appear (Tripuraneni Gopichand vs Pullela Gopichand); Arasam (progressive, 1943) vs Virasam (revolutionary, 1970).
Work-author match items (Mahaprasthanam, Gabbilam, Gudiselu Kalipotunnayi) fit APPSC style.
App MCQs go deeper (dedication of Mahaprasthanam, banned Virasam books, publishers) than the PYQs show.
